mapper.select:
select count(*)
from member
join space on car.spc_no = space.spc_no
where member id=#{id} and member.car_type = 0 and space.spc_type (1) and car.car_stat = 1 and space.spc_stat = 1

select sum(total_spc) as total_spc, (select count(*) from car where car_stat in (0, 1, 3) ) as parking_car,
sum(total_spc) - ( select count(*) from car where car_stat in (0, 1, 3) ) as available_spc
from parking

select floor, count(*) filter (where spc_type = 0 and spc_stat = 0) as normal_spc, count(*) filter (where spc_type = 1 and spc_stat = 0) as elec_spc, count(*) filter (where spc_type = 2 and spc_stat = 0) as dis_spc
from space
group by floor
order by floor asc

select spc_no, floor, spc_type, spc_stat
from space
order by floor, spc_no
